title: Proxima
tagline: Join the future of remote meetings with our token gated decentralised platform! Features incl whiteboard, code editor, compiler, transcripts & reports for secure & efficient virtual collaboration. #decentralized #meetings #collaboration
description:
Proxima is a Collaborative Decentralized Video Meeting Website designed exclusively for developers to enhance their virtual collaboration and communication efforts. The platform provides real-time audio/video conferencing, file sharing, and a live code share feature, making it an ideal solution for developers who want to work together on projects.

Proxima is built on a decentralized infrastructure powered by blockchain technology, providing users with a transparent and secure environment for collaboration. The decentralized architecture ensures that user data is protected from centralized server attacks, giving developers peace of mind during virtual meetings.

One of the standout features of Proxima is its live code share file, which allows developers to work on code together in real-time. Coders also get the option to compile and run the code to test the working. It is also accompanied with a built-in whiteboard, to make notes and discuss things more easily and visually. The code and whiteboard file is saved on Lighthouse, a decentralized storage platform that ensures that the code remains secure and accessible even if the website goes offline.

For each meeting, we are generating transcripts for better documenting process. The user-friendly interface and intuitive design of Proxima make it easy for developers to participate in virtual meetings and code sessions, even if they are not tech-savvy. The platform is designed to provide a seamless and hassle-free experience, allowing developers to focus on their work and not the technology behind it.

In conclusion, Proxima is a comprehensive solution for developers looking to collaborate and communicate effectively in a secure and private environment. With real-time audio/video conferencing, file sharing, and a live code share feature, the platform provides developers with the tools they need to work together effectively on projects.
how_its_made:
Proxima is a cutting-edge Collaborative Decentralized Video Meeting Website that is built using a combination of several technologies. These technologies include:

Socket.io: Proxima uses Socket.io to facilitate real-time communication between the client and server. This enables the platform to provide real-time audio/video conferencing and live code sharing, allowing developers to work together in real-time.

Lighthouse: Proxima leverages the power of Lighthouse, a decentralized storage platform, to store and secure the live code share file. This ensures that the code remains accessible even if the website goes offline, and protects the code from centralized server attacks.

React: The front-end of Proxima is built using React, a popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. React enables the platform to provide a user-friendly and intuitive interface for developers to participate in virtual meetings and code sessions.

Node.js: Proxima's back-end is built using Node.js, a powerful server-side JavaScript platform. Node.js provides the platform with the scalability and performance it needs to handle large numbers of users and real-time communication.

QuillJS: Proxima utilizes QuillJS, a popular JavaScript library for building rich text editors, to provide the live code share feature. QuillJS allows developers to edit and share code in real-time, making it an essential component of the platform.
